payload.title: The real-repo-baseline fixture case carries its own hand copy of the manifest's default_input.roots, the fixture runner passes it as the whole input, and no test asserts the two lists agree, so a root added to the manifest is never exercised by the baseline
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/fixtures/infrastructure-policy-adapter/cases/real-repo-baseline.json:4-27 (input.roots, a hand-written list of the 20 roots)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/fixture_runner.py:926 (the case's input is taken as the adapter input as written)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/fixture_runner.py:946 (input_bytes are the case input; no merge with the manifest default_input)
tools/aria-adapters/adapter-fs.ts:395-402 (the repository's own statement of this danger: a second copy lets fixtures validate a file set production never scans, with every test green)
tools/aria-adapters/infrastructure-policy-adapter.test.ts:1507-1509 (the adapter test runs manifest.default_input.roots; nothing reads the fixture case)
payload.rule_violated: adapter-fs.ts requireScanRoots contract: the scan surface is declared once in default_input.roots; callers outside the cycle pass the same roots rather than a copy that can drift.
payload.notes: The two lists are equal today (checked), and this change edited both by hand. The next root added to or removed from default_input.roots leaves the baseline fixture running against the old list: the baseline lane (clean: true, max_findings 200) then measures a surface production no longer scans, and no test turns red, which is the failure adapter-fs.ts documents. Close condition: Add an assertion in infrastructure-policy-adapter.test.ts that the real-repo-baseline case's input.roots deep-equals manifest.default_input.roots, or generate the case input from the manifest. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 2b). Verified at head b2259fe03f of open pull request #2151; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
